items.exampleEn: Most undergraduates live in the dorms during their first year.
items.exampleZh: 大部分大學部學生在第一年住宿舍。

items.exampleEn: Copper turns green after many years in the rain.
items.exampleZh: 銅淋雨多年後會變成綠色。

items.exampleEn: The company sells its products in every geographic region of the country.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司在全國每個地理區域都有販售產品。

items.exampleEn: She is a well-educated woman who speaks four languages.
items.exampleZh: 她是一位受過良好教育、會說四種語言的女士。

items.exampleEn: The archaeologist gave a talk at our school about life in ancient times.
items.exampleZh: 那位考古學家來我們學校演講，介紹古代人的生活。

items.exampleEn: My teacher said my sentence was too long and should be split into two clauses.
items.exampleZh: 老師說我的句子太長，應該拆成兩個子句。

items.exampleEn: Ancient sailors used astronomy to find their way across the sea.
items.exampleZh: 古代水手利用天文學在海上辨認方向。

items.exampleEn: Bees build their homes in a near-perfect mathematical pattern.
items.exampleZh: 蜜蜂築巢的形狀幾乎是完美的數學圖案。

items.sentenceEn: My cousin is an undergraduate studying engineering in the south.
items.sentenceZh: 我表弟是在南部念工程的大學部學生。

items.audioEn: The astronomy club will meet on the roof tonight to watch the moon, so bring something warm.
items.audioZh: 天文社今晚在屋頂集合賞月，記得帶件保暖的衣物。
items.questionZh: 說話者提醒大家帶什麼？

items.sentenceEn: In this sentence, the clause after 'because' explains the reason.
items.sentenceZh: 這個句子裡，because 後面的子句在解釋原因。

items.sentenceEn: Electric wires are usually made of copper.

items.stemEn: She has a ____ mind and can solve hard number puzzles in seconds.
items.stemZh: 她有數學頭腦，幾秒鐘就能解開困難的數字謎題。

items.stemEn: The ____ carefully brushed the dirt off an ancient bowl.
items.stemZh: 那位考古學家小心地把古碗上的泥土刷掉。

items.passageEn: This summer, a group of undergraduates joined an archaeologist on a dig in the mountains. The site's geographic position, high above a river valley, made it a perfect place for an ancient town. The students found copper tools, broken pots and a stone covered with strange marks. One student, who loves astronomy, noticed that the marks matched the positions of certain stars. The archaeologist was impressed and said it was an educated guess worth testing. Later, the team used mathematical models to check the idea. The research is not finished, but the students said the long, hot days of digging took real endurance.
items.passageZh: 今年夏天，一群大學部學生跟著一位考古學家到山區挖掘。這個遺址的地理位置在河谷高處，是古代城鎮的理想地點。學生們挖到銅製工具、破陶罐，以及一塊刻滿奇怪記號的石頭。一位熱愛天文學的學生注意到，這些記號和某些星星的位置吻合。考古學家很驚喜，說這是值得驗證的合理推測。後來，團隊用數學模型檢驗這個想法。研究還沒完成，但學生們說，在大熱天裡連日挖掘真的很需要耐力。

questions.questionZh: 那位愛天文學的學生注意到什麼？
options: 陶罐上刻著一幅古老地圖
記號和星星的位置吻合
銅製工具其實是現代做的

questions.questionZh: 團隊後來怎麼檢驗這個想法？

items.promptZh: 合約裡有一條關於取消的條款。
referenceEn: There is a clause about how to cancel it in the contract.
The contract has a clause about how to cancel it.
rubricZh: clause 指合約的「條款」（例如 a clause about…）
句型可寫，例如 There is… in the contract、The contract has… 等

items.instructionZh: 用 astronomy 造一個句子，說說你對天文學的興趣或經驗。
referenceEn: I became interested in astronomy after I saw a shooting star.
I'm not very good at astronomy, but I love looking at the moon.
rubricZh: 時態合理即可（例如 became、love）
